show_skeletons: create an OpenGL viewer to visualize 3D human body skeletons from multiple motion capture data formats
render_smpl_mesh: render SMPL body meshes with computed normals using OpenGL VAO and VBO buffers
set_camera_view: set a camera projection matrix from a 3x3 intrinsic K matrix for MTC camera visualization
save_rendered_scene: save the rendered OpenGL scene to a JPEG image file in a specified output folder
visualize_face_keypoints: draw 70-point face keypoints with edges following OpenPose format in the 3D viewer
